Job Description

Seeking a skilled .NET developer to join our team and contribute to the development of the software
using .NET infrastructure. The work profile includes fine tuning, upgrading or creating applications
from the start and providing support wherever necessary.

Responsibilities
● Participate in requirement analysis
● Collaborate with internal teams for design and architecture
● Write clean code with minimum or no dependency on external utilities
● Test and deploy the application
● Revise, update and debug code thus improving the software
● Providing support mainly technically
● Should support well as a team player.
● Good problem-solving skills

Requirement and skill (Items in bold are must have)
● Platform: .NET Framework 4.5 and above, .NET Core
● Languages: C#, ASP.NET
● DB: MS SQL Server, ORACLE - exposure is good to have
● Reports and services: SSIS (ETL Packages), SSRS, SSAS
● Scripting: Javascripts, Jquery - Exposure will be useful
● Utilities: MS Office
● Basic retail banking domain knowledge is essential.
● Application security is important, hence familiarity with OWASP standards would be helpful.
● Using SVN
● Familiarity with Webservices, RESTful APIs development and integration
